title: Reading grade by surface
notes: Reuses scanReadabilityForRoots() from scripts/ui-copy-readability.mjs (the same Flesch-Kincaid scorer that already gates `ui-copy:readability`), grouped by route family instead of pooled. student = student_home+career+goals+orientation+settings+connect_student; employer = teacher_connect+employer_page (the job-developer console and the public employer response page, held to the same 8th-grade ceiling as Sage's own replies rather than the 6th-grade student floor). Per-family median/max and the worst offenders sit in each metric's `details`.
